QuestInfo.name: The Arrogant Alien Gray
QuestInfo.0: I better negotiate with #r#p2050002##k so the machine can be sent to Showa Town ASAP.
QuestInfo.1: After eating lunch, #r#p2050002##k claims that he'll send the machine to Showa Town, no problem. \nThis really irritated me, but I'll have to gather up #b400#k #b#t4000117#s#k in order for that to happen.\r\n#t4000117# #b#c4000117##k/400
QuestInfo.2: Just as #r#p2050002##k demanded, I got him #b400 #t4000117#s#k.

0.0: I know I can send you the machine... but...I'll do it if you get something for me. What do you think?

yes.0: Well, it's nothing big... and I need some stamina to transport this machine, you know, and I feel like eating lunch beforehand.
yes.1: And so, I would like to eat my favorite, #b400#k #b#t4000117#s#k, so it would be nice for you to bring me lunch...
yes.2: Hey, you seem strong enough. Just take care of the monsters around the area, and you'll have enough in a hurry. Hahaha!

no.0: Eh? That's alright. It's not like I'm going through too much trouble here, but I suggest you do things my way.

1.0: Wooo, not bad for a human. Well, let's be friends now.
1.1: As promised, the machine will be sent to #r#p9120005##k, so you should go there too and see it for yourself.

item.0: Are you kidding me? Don't mess with me, or I am not giving you the machine!
